import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def up(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["sequence"]["value"]
seqs={n:up(a) for n,a in {"APG6":"Q8WZY7","yAtg8":"P38182","LC3B":"Q9GZQ8","GABARAP":"O95166"}.items()}

B62_TXT="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
L=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); B={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            c=[M[i-1,j-1]+s,X[i-1,j-1]+s,Y[i-1,j-1]+s]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); M[i,j]=c[k]; pM[i,j]=k
            c=[M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); X[i,j]=c[k]; pX[i,j]=k
            c=[M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Y[i,j]=c[k]; pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');st=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=pY[i,j];j-=1
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
def refmap(q,r):
    a,b=nw(q,r); mi=mj=0; m={}
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!='-': mi+=1
        if y!='-': mj+=1
        if x!='-' and y!='-': m[mj]=mi
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y and x!='-'); al=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    return m,ident,al

def pdb(pid):
    t=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=60); t.raise_for_status(); t=t.text
    atoms=[]
    for ln in t.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            atoms.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),res=ln[17:20].strip(),chain=ln[21],seq=int(ln[22:26]),
                              x=float(ln[30:38]),y=float(ln[38:46]),z=float(ln[46:54])))
        elif ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
    return atoms
def contacts(atoms,pc,qc,cut=4.5,qres=None):
    P=[a for a in atoms if a['chain']==pc]; Q=[a for a in atoms if a['chain']==qc and (qres is None or a['seq'] in qres)]
    A=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in P]); Bq=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in Q])
    d=np.sqrt(((A[:,None]-Bq[None])**2).sum(-1)); h=defaultdict(lambda:1e9)
    for i,j in zip(*np.where(d<=cut)):
        k=(P[i]['seq'],AA3.get(P[i]['res'],'X')); h[k]=min(h[k],d[i,j])
    return dict(h)

at=pdb("2ZPN")
copies=[('A','E'),('B','F'),('C','G'),('D','H')]
cons=defaultdict(int); mind=defaultdict(lambda:1e9); Wc=defaultdict(int); Lc=defaultdict(int)
for p,q in copies:
    for r,d in contacts(at,p,q).items(): cons[r]+=1; mind[r]=min(mind[r],d)
    for r in contacts(at,p,q,qres={1}): Wc[r]+=1
    for r in contacts(at,p,q,qres={4}): Lc[r]+=1
core=sorted(r for r,n in cons.items() if n>=3)
print("2ZPN = S. cerevisiae Atg8 + Atg19 AIM peptide (WEEL, residues 412-415)")
print(f"AIM-contact residues (<=4.5 A) reproduced in >=3 of 4 copies: {len(core)}")

m_y,id_y,al_y = refmap(seqs['APG6'], seqs['yAtg8'])
m_g,id_g,al_g = refmap(seqs['APG6'], seqs['GABARAP'])
m_l,id_l,al_l = refmap(seqs['APG6'], seqs['LC3B'])
print(f"\nAPG-6 vs yeast Atg8: {id_y}/{al_y} = {100*id_y/al_y:.1f}% id")
print(f"APG-6 vs GABARAP  : {id_g}/{al_g} = {100*id_g/al_g:.1f}% id")
print(f"APG-6 vs LC3B     : {id_l}/{al_l} = {100*id_l/al_l:.1f}% id")

apg=seqs['APG6']
rows=[]
for pos,aa in core:
    qp=m_y.get(pos); qa=apg[qp-1] if qp else None
    pk=[]
    if Wc.get((pos,aa),0)>=3: pk.append("HP1 (W-site)")
    if Lc.get((pos,aa),0)>=3: pk.append("HP2 (L-site)")
    rows.append(dict(yeast_Atg8=f"{aa}{pos}", APG6=f"{qa}{qp}" if qp else "-", identical=(qa==aa),
                     pocket=" + ".join(pk) if pk else "rim", min_dist_A=round(mind[(pos,aa)],2),
                     n_copies=cons[(pos,aa)]))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== AIM/LIR docking site: yeast Atg8 -> N. crassa APG-6 ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
nid=int(df.identical.sum())
print(f"\nIdentical at {nid}/{len(df)} AIM-contact positions ({100*nid/len(df):.0f}%)")
print("Non-identical:", df[~df.identical].to_dict('records'))
hp = df[df.pocket!="rim"]
print(f"\nPocket-lining only (HP1/HP2): identical at {int(hp.identical.sum())}/{len(hp)}")
df.to_csv("out/apg6_AIM_site_conservation.csv", index=False)

# background identity for a fair comparison
bg = 100*id_y/al_y
obs = 100*nid/len(df)
from scipy.stats import binomtest
bt = binomtest(nid, len(df), bg/100, alternative='greater')
print(f"\nAIM-site identity {obs:.0f}% vs whole-protein background {bg:.1f}%; binomial p={bt.pvalue:.3f} (one-sided, enrichment)")

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.2),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.15,1]})
ax=axes[0]
cm_pos=[m_y[p] for p,a in core if p in m_y]
ident_mask=[apg[m_y[p]-1]==a for p,a in core if p in m_y]
pk_mask=[(Wc.get((p,a),0)>=3 or Lc.get((p,a),0)>=3) for p,a in core if p in m_y]
ax.bar(range(1,len(apg)+1),[1]*len(apg),color="#d8d8d8",width=1.0)
for p,ok,pk in zip(cm_pos,ident_mask,pk_mask):
    ax.bar([p],[1],color=("#1f6f4a" if ok else "#c0392b"),width=1.0)
    if pk: ax.plot([p],[1.12],marker="v",color="#2b4c7e",ms=5)
ax.bar([116],[1],color="#e8a33d",width=1.0)
ax.annotate("Gly116\n(Atg4 cleavage,\nPE acceptor)",xy=(116,1.0),xytext=(92,1.55),fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#b8761a"),color="#8a5a10")
ax.annotate("C-terminal extension\n117-DFETA-121",xy=(119,0.5),xytext=(70,0.25),fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#555"),color="#333")
ax.bar(range(117,122),[1]*5,color="#9b8ec4",width=1.0)
ax.set_xlim(0,126); ax.set_ylim(0,1.9); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("APG-6 residue number (UniProt Q8WZY7, 121 aa)")
ax.set_title("N. crassa APG-6 mapped onto the S. cerevisiae Atg8 AIM-docking site (PDB 2ZPN)",fontsize=11)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(color="#1f6f4a",label="AIM-contact, identical to yeast Atg8"),
                   Patch(color="#c0392b",label="AIM-contact, substituted"),
                   Patch(color="#e8a33d",label="Gly116"),
                   Patch(color="#9b8ec4",label="C-terminal propeptide"),
                   Line2D([],[],marker="v",color="#2b4c7e",ls="",label="lines HP1 or HP2")],
          fontsize=8,ncol=3,loc="upper left")

ax=axes[1]
names=["APG-6 (N. crassa)","Atg8 (S. cerevisiae)","GABARAP (human)","LC3B (human)"]
tails=["S G E N T F G | D F E T A","S G E N T F G | R","D E S V Y G | L","Q E T F G | M K L S V"]
cleav=[116,116,116,120]
for i,(n,t,c) in enumerate(zip(names,tails,cleav)):
    ax.text(0.01,0.82-0.24*i,n,fontsize=10,transform=ax.transAxes,va="center")
    ax.text(0.34,0.82-0.24*i,t,fontsize=11,family="monospace",transform=ax.transAxes,va="center")
    ax.text(0.80,0.82-0.24*i,f"Gly{c} exposed",fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes,va="center",color="#8a5a10")
ax.text(0.34,0.98,"C-terminus, '|' = Atg4/ATG4B scissile bond",fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes,va="center",color="#444")
ax.axis("off")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
